description: This is a test script for a Flask web application's health check and OpenAPI route. It sets environment variables, creates a test client, and performs assertions to verify the application's health status and OpenAPI JSON endpoint.

methods.name: client()
methods.description: Pytest fixture that creates and yields a test client for the Flask app.

methods.name: test_health(client)
methods.description: Test that the '/health' endpoint returns status 200 and a JSON object with 'status' == 'ok'.

methods.name: test_openapi_json(client)
methods.description: Test that the '/openapi.json' endpoint returns status 200 or 404, ensuring route registration does not error.
